items.stem: Which of the following pairs of species react to give a compound with a giant covalent structure?

options.text: it is the hardest element in the world.
the atoms in it are bonded by strong covalent bonds.
the atoms in it are held together by van der Waals' forces.

items.stem: Diamond has a very high melting point because

options.text: it has a giant covalent structure with strong C–C covalent bonds throughout the lattice.
it is held by weak van der Waals’ forces.
it contains delocalized electrons like a metal.
